description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 修好了长截图之后屏幕上留下空框的问题：长截图结束后，“长图预览”原来的位置会留下一个只有边框和阴影的圆角空框，一直不消失。权限不变。
notes.en: Fixed an empty frame left on the screen after a long screenshot: where the long screenshot's preview had been, a rounded frame with only its edge and shadow stayed behind. Permissions unchanged.
